problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute municipal resources across 19 different infrastructure projects to maximize the overall efficiency of the city's development plan. The profile for each project is as follows:
* Project A: efficiency score is 0.117, implementation difficulty is 0.070, allocation limits [0.008, 0.879]
* Project B: efficiency score is 0.028, implementation difficulty is 0.215, allocation limits [0.091, 0.336]
* Project C: efficiency score is 0.164, implementation difficulty is 0.246, allocation limits [0.084, 0.813]
* Project D: efficiency score is 0.177, implementation difficulty is 0.270, allocation limits [0.052, 0.530]
* Project E: efficiency score is 0.065, implementation difficulty is 0.259, allocation limits [0.030, 0.311]
* Project F: efficiency score is 0.030, implementation difficulty is 0.139, allocation limits [0.055, 0.530]
* Project G: efficiency score is 0.030, implementation difficulty is 0.098, allocation limits [0.012, 0.566]
* Project H: efficiency score is 0.099, implementation difficulty is 0.116, allocation limits [0.072, 0.435]
* Project I: efficiency score is 0.071, implementation difficulty is 0.170, allocation limits [0.079, 0.528]
* Project J: efficiency score is 0.077, implementation difficulty is 0.262, allocation limits [0.004, 0.696]
* Project K: efficiency score is 0.128, implementation difficulty is 0.081, allocation limits [0.024, 0.619]
* Project L: efficiency score is 0.180, implementation difficulty is 0.269, allocation limits [0.044, 0.696]
* Project M: efficiency score is 0.200, implementation difficulty is 0.102, allocation limits [0.076, 0.319]
* Project N: efficiency score is 0.043, implementation difficulty is 0.167, allocation limits [0.095, 0.758]
* Project O: efficiency score is 0.092, implementation difficulty is 0.040, allocation limits [0.002, 0.862]
* Project P: efficiency score is 0.138, implementation difficulty is 0.111, allocation limits [0.084, 0.846]
* Project Q: efficiency score is 0.138, implementation difficulty is 0.129, allocation limits [0.027, 0.753]
* Project R: efficiency score is 0.034, implementation difficulty is 0.286, allocation limits [0.059, 0.502]
* Project S: efficiency score is 0.189, implementation difficulty is 0.151, allocation limits [0.030, 0.797]

Each project must receive a resource allocation that falls within its specified minimum and maximum limits, and the sum of all allocations must equal the total available budget of one unit. To ensure adequate public visibility, the planner requires that the group of high-visibility projects, represented by the set H = {A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, Q, R}, collectively receive at least 0.815 of the total resources. Additionally, the overall implementation complexity of the portfolio, measured by a composite difficulty index, must not exceed 0.209, and the total efficiency score of the portfolio must be at least 0.085. Determine the optimal resource allocation that maximizes the total efficiency score while satisfying all constraints.
